projects.title: AI-Driven Portable Water Quality and Contamination Detector
projects.description: An ESP32-S3-based portable device using multiple sensors and a TinyML artificial neural network to classify water safety into three categories, paired with a Flutter and Firebase mobile app for real-time monitoring.

projects.title: Campus Network Simulation
projects.description: A full campus network topology designed and configured in Cisco Packet Tracer, including switch and router configuration, VLAN segmentation, IP addressing, and inter-VLAN routing.

projects.title: Access Point Configuration (SIWES)
projects.description: Configured a wireless access point during SIWES industrial training at C2P Tech Hub, Department of Computer Engineering, ABU Zaria, supporting practical Cisco IOS configuration sessions for students.
